messages:
maya: Heads-up: us-west1 pool-7 reporting an unusual spike in memory remap activity across a handful of GPUs. Dash shows remap_count +31 in last 30m and ECC corrected errors up ~3x.
jon: which nodes are spiking?
maya: gw-usw1-71, gw-usw1-74, gw-usw1-76, gw-usw1-80 — 71 is the worst.
kai: got NVML dumps? suspect progressive cell failures or a firmware regression.
maya: pasted nvml short from gw-usw1-71: 
``
GPU 0: A100-40GB
  Page retirement count : 4123
  ECC errors (corrected) : 128
  Xid errors (recent) : 62
GPU 1: A100-40GB
  Page retirement count : 58
  ECC errors (corrected) : 2
```
kai: Xid 62 + high page-retire indicates remap table churn. Not transient. Recommend draining node-71.
sasha: agree. Our runbook says: if page-retire > 4000 and rising => schedule replacement.
jon: I'll also flag autoscaler to avoid placing pods on pool-7 while we triage.
maya: initiating cordon/drain on gw-usw1-71 now. Command: 
``
# cordon & drain
kubectl cordon gpu-node-71
kubectl drain gpu-node-71 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --grace-period=120
```
infra-bot: Maintenance ticket created: INC-2026 — drain in progress, replacement proc started.
kai: grabbing dmesg snippet from gw-usw1-71: 
``
[3452.123456] NVRM: Xid (62): 0x00000001, emc: remap table triggered
[3452.123467] NVRM: GPU 0000:81:00.0: Page retire event: row remap occurred
```
jon: once drained, recommend run a memory stress (memtest-style) and firmware sanity check. If remap_count increases after reboot, treat as confirmed hardware degradation.
sasha: also gather BIOS/PSB and vendor FW versions. We had mixed FW in recent shipments; that correlated with remap spikes in staging.
maya: note — shifting some jobs to us-east1 spares to preserve SLAs. Will incur extra cost while replacements are pending.
kai: for replacements, collect serial numbers, manufacture dates, board PMIC logs. If under warranty escalate to vendor RMA.
jon: mitigation: pin critical workloads to nodes with remap_count < 100 and disable pool burst for pool-7.
sasha: action items:
- maya: complete drain of gw-usw1-71, snapshot nvml + attach SNs to INC-2026
- kai: run extended memtest on gw-usw1-74 and gw-usw1-76 in a quiet window
- jon: update autoscaler policies and add temporary cost alert for cross-region spill
maya: attaching full NVML output and quick ticket summary to INC-2026: "Progressive rise in GPU page-remaps on gw-usw1-71/74/76/80. Node 71 exceeded remap threshold and shows Xid=62 kernel events. Drained node 71; 74 queued for observation. Procure/replace if counts climb after firmware validation and burn-in."
infra-bot: INC-2026 status: open -> in_progress. ETA for hardware replacement procurement: 3 business days (prelim).
kai: FYI vendor notes: older firmware 520.x exhibited similar symptoms; many clusters improved with vendor FW 525.89. Recommend firmware verification before redeploy.
sasha: please avoid bulk reboots unless nodes are drained. Keep a 4h observation window for 76/80 before making replacement calls.
jon: I'll set a temporary budget cap and alert to catch cross-region cost ramp while we spill to us-east1.
maya: will post final postmortem in INC-2026 and ping #eng-infra when replacements are staged. Thanks. :thumbsup:
